neutral_facts.value: The accused, who was married to the victim, was involved in an illicit relationship with another woman. The prosecution presented documentary evidence, including an agreement executed before a panchayat, where the accused admitted to living with another woman and agreed to sever the relationship and live with his wife. Witnesses testified that the accused continued the relationship with the other woman after the panchayat. The victim, who was married to the accused within four months, committed suicide by jumping into a well. The prosecution argued that the accused's actions, including the illicit relationship and alleged dowry harassment, created a psychological imbalance in the victim, leading to her suicide.

legal_principle_applied.value: The court applied the principle that abetment involves a mental process of instigating or aiding a person in doing an act, and that courts must assess the facts of each case to determine if the cruelty meted out to the victim induced her to commit suicide.

quotes.text: Abetment involves a mental process of instigating a person or in any manner aiding that person in doing of the thing. Courts should carefully assess the facts of each case before deciding whether the cruelty meted out to the victim which induces her to commit suicide
